# Content Machine
> Turns one long video into a consistent, scheduled stream of short vertical videos for TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts, driven by Claude.

- [Run playbook](playbook/run.md): what Claude does when a user says "Using Content Machine: <link>"
